facts.business: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited is a diversified, technology-driven rigid packaging leader in India with a growing portfolio of products and capabilities.

capacity_or_capex.item: Property, Plant and Equipment capitalised during FY 2025-26
Capital expenditure contracted but not recognised as liabilities

guidance_or_targets.statement: Product range from collaboration with Vibe Generation Holdings will start contributing revenues

key_risks: Volatility in crude oil and raw material prices
Risk of revenue being recorded before control over goods is transferred
Risk of ineligible costs being capitalised as Property, Plant and Equipment
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arms' length basis, in the ordinary course of business, and in compliance with applicable provisions. No materially significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest. Transactions include purchases from Friends Packaging Industries (₹436.75 lakhs), Capricorn Industries (₹450.87 lakhs), Dynamic Metal Industries Pvt Ltd (₹267.51 lakhs), services from Sri Kanaka Durga Mini Transport (₹103.02 lakhs) and JSS Pro Services Private Limited (₹6.78 lakhs), acquisition of shares of Mold-Tek Technologies Limited (₹70.60 lakhs), and remuneration to KMPs.
